name: cure-bench-reasoning-traces
description:
CURE-Bench Reasoning Traces
	

This dataset contains reasoning traces from the CURE-Bench evaluation, formatted for training language models.

	
		
		Dataset Structure
	

The dataset contains 10 examples with the following fields:

expected_answer: The correct answer to the problem
problem_type: Type of problem (e.g., multiple_choice_medical)
problem_source: Source of the problem (e.g., cure_bench_fda)
generation_model: Model used to generate the solution
pass_rate_72b_tir: Pass rate… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/update0909/cure-bench-reasoning-traces.
reputation: A specialized dataset of reasoning traces from the CURE-Bench suite intended for model training and analysis in medical question reasoning; limited but relevant within safety/medical ML evaluation circles.
